## Key Facts

- FY2019 total revenues were $81,166,160 or $2,311 per capita [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- FY2019 total expenses were $70,324,365 or $2,002 per capita [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- FY2019 net position increased by $10,841,795 ($309 per capita) [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- FY2019 property tax rate was $0.5146 per $100 valuation, up from $0.4910 in 2018 [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- City employed 357.0 full-time equivalent positions in FY2019 [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- Estimated population in FY2019 was 35,121 [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- Ad valorem taxes were the largest revenue source at $19,151,005 (43.5% of governmental revenues) [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
- Sales taxes were the second largest revenue source at $12,506,879 [SOURCE: Financial Summary and Charts]
